name: EarthWalk Summer Camps
description_short: Small group forest camps at the Fairbanks Museum Nature Preserve at Matsinger Forest in Danville, 9am to 3pm on weekdays. Forest Explorers (ages 6 to 9) and Forest Adventurers (9 to 12) learn naturalist and outdoor skills like shelter building, fire making and wood carving, and a Teen Leaders week (13 to 16) builds trails and bridges.
notes: 2026 season shown. Run by EarthWalk, an independent nonprofit, on the Fairbanks Museum's preserve; registration and payment go through EarthWalk. Two forest educators and two teen mentors in training per group, about one adult to six campers. Each child could register for one session at first. Sibling discounts and some financial aid. Teen Leaders also have three Saturday stewardship days (July 18, August 8, August 22).
